# @nwire/cache

> 标签: adapter, cache, nwire, redis, ttl

## 简介

Nwire — key/value cache contract + InMemoryCache (TTL) default + cachePlugin. Adapters (Redis/Valkey/Upstash) live in separate packages.

- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nwire/cache
